notice: Historical context, not local quotations or recommended defaults. No automatic currency conversion or input replacement.

benchmarks.label: Capital cost
benchmarks.limitation: Historical regional average, not a country estimate, price quote or uncertainty range. Confirm included cost items and connection definition.

benchmarks.label: Operating cost
benchmarks.limitation: Reported operating average; not a replacement reserve, debt payment or site-specific maintenance budget.

local_context.label: Rwanda productive-use field study
local_context.finding: Field testing involved 12 entrepreneurs in four districts.
local_context.limitation: Small appliance pilot, not a representative mini-grid uptake survey. No transferable operating-hours or business-growth coefficient is adopted.

local_context.label: Kenya milling assessment guide
local_context.finding: Practical guidance for assessing milling enterprises.
local_context.limitation: A guide, not measured demand at the selected site. Survey crop throughput, competition, runtime, finance and ability to pay.

local_context.label: Rwanda tariff reference
local_context.finding: Published utility tariffs have customer categories and consumption blocks.
local_context.limitation: Not automatically the tariff for an independent mini-grid. Obtain the applicable site tariff and approvals; the app uses an entered flat tariff.
